DeferredDate.name: Deferred Date
DeferredDate.definition: Indicate the date the transaction will be settled.

Period.name: Period
Period.definition: Identifies the settlement period, cycle or group. May contain settlement frequency or the identification of specific settlement period. For example, daily, monthly or settlementperiod123acd.

CutOffTime.name: Cut Off Time
CutOffTime.definition: Identifies the effective end time of the settlement date and/or period.

ReportingEntityType.name: Reporting Entity Type
ReportingEntityType.definition: Identifies the type of settlement reporting entity

ReportingEntityIdentification.name: Reporting Entity Identification
ReportingEntityIdentification.definition: Identification of the settlement reporting entity.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
